jobs.title: ArcGIS Enterprise Platform Specialist / Senior GIS Systems Administrator/ ETL & Development
jobs.description:
**Job Title: ArcGIS Enterprise Platform Specialist / Senior GIS Systems Administrator/ ETL & Development**

**Location: Remote**

**Job Duties/Requirements:**

* ArcGIS Enterprise experience and support in these areas:
  + Architecture, configuration, maintenance, and installation
  + Administration
  + User management
    - Licensing and entitlement management: named-user types, SAML, OpenID
  + Data Store: installation, configuration, maintenance, backups, and troubleshooting of relational, tile-cache, and spatiotemporal data stores
  + Image Server: configuration, mosaic dataset management, image service publishing, caching, and support for imagery workflows
  + Monitor or other metrics reporting
  + Dashboards
  + Experience Builder
  + Field Maps
  + API for Python and REST API proficiency for automation, reporting, and troubleshooting
  + Hosting
    - Service publishing and performance: map/feature/image services, caching/tiling, symbology, and basic tuning
  + Backup and restore
    - Component backups, high-availability awareness, and ArcGIS Enterprise upgrade experience
* GIS Systems
  + GIS data support and creation expertise
    - Enterprise GDB experience
    - Enterprise geodatabase depth: branch versioning (or traditional), editor tracking, archiving, replicas, and extract-changes patterns for feature audits
    - System design
    - Backup, restore, and upgrade: WebGISDR, equivalent or GeoJobe, component backups, high-availability awareness, and ArcGIS Enterprise upgrade experience
  + Open Source use
    - PostGIS
    - GeoServer
    - Other
* FME/ETL
  + Experience (automation, authoring workbenches)
* Scripting
  + Python expertise
  + PowerShell for Windows/IIS tasks
* General technology experience
  + Troubleshooting complex systems and architectures
  + TLS/SSL certificate signing and import expertise
  + Windows Server and IIS administration plus basic networking (DNS, certificates, firewall ports, load-balancer awareness)
  + Documentation and knowledge transfer: SOPs, architecture diagrams, and runbooks that support the policy set
  + Stakeholder coordination

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in geography, math, computer science, or related.
* A minimum of 6 years of experience.
* An equivalent combination of advanced education, training, and experience will be considered.

**Disclaimer**

**Equal Employment Opportunity:**

**Themesoft Inc** is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

**Work Authorization**: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

jobs.title: ArcGIS Enterprise Platform Specialist / Senior GIS Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
UNIVERSAL Technologies is seeking a hands-on **ArcGIS Enterprise Platform Specialist / Senior GIS Systems Administrator with at least 6-years of ArcGIS Administration, Architecture, Configuration and maintenance.** This is a **remote role – must reside in the EST zone**, responsible for assisting in the day-to-day administration of ArcGIS Enterprise and its supporting GIS infrastructure. **Active LinkedIn preferred**. The role spans installation through upgrades, licensing and identity, data stores, service publishing, monitoring, backup/restore, and enterprise geodatabase patterns, plus complementary open-source and ETL tooling and development. Strong documentation and stakeholder coordination are required to ensure operational knowledge is transferred and retained.

**WHO WE ARE**

UNIVERSAL Technologies, LLC is a certified Women-Owned Business Enterprise (M/WBE) providing IT consulting and solutions to government and private-sector clients. Our expertise spans Application Development, Business and Systems Analysis, Data Analytics, Project Management, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure and Network Engineering, and Enterprise Architecture.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Competitive compensation
* Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Group Life Insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Pre-Tax Transportation Benefits
* Generous Paid Time Off and Holidays

**MANDATORY SKILLS/EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's Degree in Geography, Math, Computer Science, or related field.
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in ArcGIS Enterprise architecture, configuration, maintenance, and installation.
* Experience with ArcGIS Enterprise administration and user management.
* .
* Experience with ArcGIS Data Store installation, configuration, maintenance, backups, and troubleshooting of relational, tile-cache, and spatiotemporal data stores.
* Experience with ArcGIS Image Server configuration, mosaic dataset management, image service publishing, caching, and support for imagery workflows.
* Experience with ArcGIS Monitor or other metrics reporting.
* Experience with ArcGIS Dashboards, Experience Builder, and Field Maps.
* Proficiency with ArcGIS API for Python and REST API for automation, reporting, and troubleshooting.
* Experience with ArcGIS Enterprise hosting, including service publishing and performance for map, feature, and image services, caching/tiling, symbology, and basic tuning.
* Experience with ArcGIS Enterprise backup and restore, including component backups, high-availability awareness, and upgrades.
* GIS data support and creation expertise.
* Experience with Enterprise Geodatabases (Enterprise GDB).
* Experience with enterprise geodatabase branch versioning (or traditional), editor tracking, archiving, replicas, and extract-changes patterns for feature audits.
* Experience with GIS system design.
* Experience with backup, restore, and upgrades using WebGISDR, equivalent solutions, or GeoJobe.
* Experience with open-source GIS technologies, including PostGIS, GeoServer, and other tools.
* Experience with FME/ETL, including automation and authoring workbenches.
* Python scripting expertise.
* Experience with PowerShell for Windows/IIS tasks.
* Experience troubleshooting complex systems and architectures.
* Expertise with TLS/SSL certificate signing and imports.
* Experience with Windows Server and IIS administration, plus basic networking, including DNS, certificates, firewall ports, and load-balancer awareness.
* Experience with documentation and knowledge transfer, including SOPs, architecture diagrams, and runbooks supporting the policy set.
* Stakeholder coordination skills.

**SCOPE OF SERVICES**

* Assist in the day-to-day administration of ArcGIS Enterprise and its supporting GIS infrastructure.
* Support ArcGIS Enterprise architecture, configuration, maintenance, installation, and administration.
* Manage ArcGIS Enterprise users, licensing, and entitlements, including named-user types, SAML, and OpenID.
* Support ArcGIS Data Store installation, configuration, maintenance, backups, and troubleshooting of relational, tile-cache, and spatiotemporal data stores.
* Support ArcGIS Image Server configuration, mosaic dataset management, image service publishing, caching, and imagery workflows.
* Utilize ArcGIS Monitor or other metrics reporting tools.
* Support ArcGIS Dashboards, Experience Builder, and Field Maps.
* Utilize ArcGIS API for Python and REST API for automation, reporting, and troubleshooting.
* Support ArcGIS Enterprise hosting, service publishing, and performance, including map, feature, and image services, caching/tiling, symbology, and basic tuning.
* Perform backup and restore activities, including component backups, with high-availability awareness and ArcGIS Enterprise upgrades.
* Provide GIS data support and creation.
* Support enterprise geodatabase management, including branch versioning (or traditional), editor tracking, archiving, replicas, and extract-changes patterns for feature audits.
* Support GIS system design.
* Perform backup, restore, and upgrade activities using WebGISDR, equivalent solutions, or GeoJobe.
* Utilize open-source GIS technologies, including PostGIS, GeoServer, and other tools.
* Perform FME/ETL automation and authoring of workbenches.
* Utilize Python scripting.
* Utilize PowerShell for Windows/IIS tasks.
* Troubleshoot complex systems and architectures.
* Support TLS/SSL certificate signing and imports.
* Perform Windows Server and IIS administration, including basic networking related to DNS, certificates, firewall ports, and load-balancer awareness.
* Develop and maintain documentation, including SOPs, architecture diagrams, and runbooks supporting the policy set.
* Coordinate with stakeholders and ensure operational knowledge is transferred and retained.

**UNIVERSAL Technologies is an equal opportunity employer.**
